verdict: Revenue held but purchase consistency is under pressure this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered $7,148.81 in revenue from 36 purchases at a 4.84 return on ad spend — a solid baseline. However, in the most recent 7 days, purchases dropped 21.43% and return on ad spend fell 69.61% week-over-week, driven by uneven daily results: 15 of the last 28 days recorded zero purchases, and revenue spikes are tracing back to single strong days rather than consistent volume. Spend also climbed 25.69% week-over-week to roughly $57.88 per day, meaning more is being invested while efficiency is compressing. We're prioritizing a creative and audience review on the top campaign to stabilize purchase consistency before scaling further. Next period, expect tighter daily purchase numbers as that review takes effect and overdue creative assets move through production.
